about_the_game:
The Vineyard is a psychological survival horror experience set in the chilling halls of the Sangnoire Estate, where madness has bloomed like the cursed vines that gave the mansion its name.
You are Marie, a young vineyard worker, trapped in a night of unspeakable horror.

What began as another quiet evening turns into a desperate escape when Julien Sangnoire, the once-respected master of the house, snaps and begins hunting his staff in a frenzy of bloodshed. With no motive, no warning — only screams and the sound of dragging chains — Marie must run, hide, and uncover the twisted secrets that lie beneath the floorboards and behind locked doors.

You Are Being Hunted

The Sangnoire mansion is not just a setting — it’s a living, shifting labyrinth filled with traps, hidden passages, and unnatural forces. Julien is always listening. Always adapting. If he hears you, he will come. If he sees you, he will chase.

You must stay quiet, stay sharp… and stay alive.

KEY FEATURES:

  • The Spiritual-Vine Mechanism
    Drinking the Sangnoire family wine doesn’t just calm the nerves. It fractures reality, opening doors that weren’t there and revealing visions from the past. But be warned: the more you drink, the harder it becomes to tell what’s real.

  • Julien Listens and Learns
    Julien Sangnoire is more than just a killer — he’s a predator. His AI behavior adapts based on your noise, your hiding spots, and your path. Every decision matters. Every sound can be your last.

  • Vintage Survival Puzzle Design
    Inspired by early 20th-century machinery, you’ll need to manipulate pressure valves, fuse boxes, mechanical lifts, and coded drawers to open new paths and escape routes. There's no hand-holding here — only tension, logic, and survival.

  • Cinematic Real-Time Horror
    Immersive, cut-free storytelling — experience ghostly memories and death sequences in real time, with no breaks in gameplay flow.

  • Explore the Sangnoire Estate
    From secret wine cellars to a forgotten chapel deep underground, the estate hides a story of grief, ritual, and madness. Each room brings you closer to the truth… and closer to Julien.

  • A Distinct Horror Aesthetic
    A moody 3D world soaked in dread, blending historical realism with unnatural beauty — overgrown vines, flickering oil lamps, and the bloodstained walls of a once-noble house.

Will you survive the Sangnoire massacre?

Or will your soul be trapped with the rest of the vineyard’s secrets?

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: SteamOS 3.0 / Ubuntu 20.04 (64-bit)
  • Processor: AMD APU (Zen 2, 4c/8t, 2.4–3.5 GHz)
  • Memory: 8000 MB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD RDNA 2
  • Storage: 64000 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Compatible with ALSA or PulseAudio
  • VR Support: Not compatible with VR
  • Additional Notes: Optimized for Steam Deck. Stable performance at 720p resolution.

Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 3 3200U / Intel Core i3-10110U
  • Memory: 8000 MB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon Vega 8 / Intel UHD Graphics
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 64000 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
  • VR Support: Not compatible with VR
  • Additional Notes: Equivalent to Steam Deck performance. Optimized for 720p at stable 30 FPS.
